name: 02 - Audio Fix: Stereo AAC 2.0 + EAC3 5.1 (No Video Re-encode)
description: Lightweight audio-only fix flow. For files already in MP4+HEVC format that are missing a stereo AAC 2.0 track. Adds stereo AAC 2.0 and EAC3 5.1 surround (where a surround source exists), removes commentary tracks (opt-in), removes DTS and other incompatible audio, reorders streams, and validates output duration. Does NOT re-encode video. Configure via the top variable nodes.

flowPlugins.name: Input File

── CONFIGURATION ─────────────────────────────
All user-configurable options are set here as
flow variables. Edit the VALUE field of each
'Set Variable' node below to configure:

  remove_commentary  (true/false)
    Remove director commentary, audio description,
    and hearing-impaired audio tracks.
    Default: true  ★ Opinionated — set false to keep.

  enable_plex_notify  (true/false)
    Trigger a Plex library refresh after each file
    is replaced. Requires Plex URL+token in the
    'Notify Plex' webRequest node near the bottom.
    Default: false  ★ Must configure URL+token first.

  enable_arr_notify  (true/false)
    Notify Radarr/Sonarr after file replacement.
    Requires API key in the 'Notify Arr' node.
    Default: false  ★ Must configure API key first.

Set Variable: remove_commentary
★ Change value to 'false' to keep commentary tracks

Set Variable: enable_plex_notify
★ Change value to 'true' to enable Plex refresh
   (also configure the webRequest node below)

Set Variable: enable_arr_notify
★ Change value to 'true' to enable Radarr/Sonarr notify
   (also configure the notifyRadarrOrSonarr node below)

── ABOUT THIS FLOW ───────────────────────────
LIGHTWEIGHT audio-only fix flow.
Does NOT re-encode video — very fast.

Purpose: Add stereo AAC 2.0 and EAC3 5.1 to files
that already have correct video (MP4+HEVC) but
may be missing the stereo audio track.

This flow:
  • Removes commentary/description tracks (opt-in)
  • Adds EAC3 5.1 surround (if surround source exists)
    → better Plex iOS direct play for surround audio
  • Adds stereo AAC 2.0 (universal fallback)
  • Removes DTS + other MP4-incompatible audio codecs
  • Reorders: stereo AAC first
  • Validates output duration
  • Optionally notifies Plex/Radarr/Sonarr
  • Stream-copies video (fast, no quality loss)

★ PREREQUISITE GUARDS:
  Files must already be MP4 + HEVC.
  Non-MP4 or non-HEVC files are skipped
  (use Flow 01 for those instead).

  NOTE: Files that already pass the stereo AAC
  guard will be skipped. To add EAC3 to files
  that already have stereo AAC, use Flow 01.

── PREREQUISITE GUARDS ───────────────────────
Ensures this flow only runs on files that
need audio processing.

Guard 1: Must be MP4/M4V container
  → If not: flow ends, use Flow 01 instead
Guard 2: Must have HEVC video
  → If not: flow ends, use Flow 01 instead

Then checks if audio fix is needed:
Guard 3: Has AAC audio stream?
Guard 4: Has 2-channel (stereo) stream?
  → BOTH pass: already has stereo AAC, skip
  → EITHER fails: route to processing pipeline

🔧 AUDIO FIX PIPELINE STARTS HERE
──────────────────────────────────────────────
File needs audio processing.
Video will be STREAM COPIED (not re-encoded).

Steps:
  1. Health check (quick)
  2. Remove commentary tracks (if enabled)
  3. Add EAC3 5.1 surround (eng + und passes)
  4. Add stereo AAC 2.0 (eng + und passes)
  5. Remove DTS + incompatible audio codecs
  6. Reorder: stereo AAC first
  7. Execute FFmpeg (stream-copy video)
  8. Validate output duration
  9. Replace original
  10. Notify Plex/arr (if enabled)

── HEALTH CHECK ──────────────────────────────
Runs a quick health check on the source file
before processing. Catches corrupt or unreadable
files early so they're marked as Error rather
than silently failing mid-transcode.

Outputs: PASS → Continue | FAIL → Fail flow

Health Check (quick)
(detects corrupt/unreadable source files)

⚠ HEALTH CHECK FAILED
Source file appears corrupt or unreadable.
Failing this file so it appears in Tdarr's
Error list for manual review.

Original file is NOT modified.
Fail Flow (health check failed)

Begin FFmpeg Command
(video and existing audio set to stream copy
by default; only new audio streams get encoded)

── STEP 1: COMMENTARY TRACK REMOVAL ──────────
Controlled by the 'remove_commentary' variable
set at the top of this flow.

★ Opt-in (default: true). To DISABLE:
  Change var_rm_commentary value to 'false'.

What gets removed (case-insensitive title match):
  • 'commentary' — director/cast commentary
  • 'description' — audio descriptions for blind
  • 'descriptive' — descriptive audio service
  • 'sdh' — hearing-impaired audio
  • 'hearing impaired' — hearing impaired audio
  • 'hearing-impaired' — alternate tag form
  • 'audio description' — AD tracks

These tracks add confusion and consume space
without being used by most home viewers.

Check: remove_commentary == 'true'?
(YES → remove commentary tracks)
(NO  → skip, keep all audio tracks)

Remove Commentary / Description / SDH Audio Tracks
(checks stream title for keywords, case-insensitive)
★ To add more keywords: edit valuesToRemove

── STEP 2: ADD EAC3 5.1 SURROUND ─────────────
Adds a 5.1 EAC3 (Dolby Digital Plus) surround
track if a suitable surround source exists.

Why EAC3 instead of keeping DTS:
  • DTS (dca) causes Plex iOS to transcode audio
  • EAC3 direct-plays on Plex iOS, Apple TV, etc.
  • EAC3 is natively supported in MP4 containers
  • AC3/EAC3 kept by Plex iOS without transcoding

Two passes:
  Pass 1 (eng): targets English-tagged audio
  Pass 2 (und): targets untagged/undefined audio

Plugin is idempotent — skips if EAC3 6ch already
exists. Only downmixes from higher-channel sources.

★ CONFIGURE:
  - bitrate: 384k (320k=smaller, 448k=better)
  - language: change for non-English libraries
  - channels: 6 (5.1 — change to 8 for 7.1)

★ OPINIONATED: This replaces DTS with EAC3.
  If you want to keep DTS, remove the 'dca'
  entry from the audio removal node's
  valuesToRemove field below.

Ensure EAC3 5.1 Surround - Pass 1 (language: eng)
★ Config: bitrate=384k | channels=6 | lang=eng

Ensure EAC3 5.1 Surround - Pass 2 (language: und)
(catches files with untagged audio streams)
★ Config: same as Pass 1 but language=und

── STEP 3: ENSURE STEREO AAC 2.0 ─────────────
Adds a 2-channel AAC downmix track if one
does not already exist.

Two passes for different language tags:
  Pass 1 (eng): targets English-tagged audio
  Pass 2 (und): targets untagged/undefined audio

The plugin finds the highest-channel-count stream
matching the language tag and downmixes it to
2-channel AAC at 192k bitrate.

If a 2ch AAC already exists, the plugin skips
addition (idempotent — safe to run multiple times).

★ CONFIGURE:
  - bitrate: 192k (128k=smaller, 256k=better)
  - language: change for non-English libraries
  - channels: 2 (stereo — don't change)
  - Add more nodes for additional languages

Ensure Stereo AAC 2.0 - Pass 1 (language: eng)
★ Config: bitrate=192k | channels=2 | lang=eng

Ensure Stereo AAC 2.0 - Pass 2 (language: und)
(catches files with untagged audio streams)
★ Config: same as Pass 1 but language=und

── STEP 4: REMOVE INCOMPATIBLE AUDIO ──────────
Removes audio codecs that are problematic for
MP4 containers or Plex iOS direct play.

  REMOVED (now includes DTS):
    truehd — Dolby TrueHD (not MP4 compatible)
    mlp    — Meridian Lossless Packing (same)
    flac   — FLAC lossless (not MP4 compatible)
    vorbis — Ogg Vorbis (not MP4 compatible)
    opus   — Opus (limited MP4 support)
    wma,wmav2,wmapro — Windows Media Audio
    dca    — DTS (causes Plex iOS transcoding)

  KEPT: aac, ac3, eac3 (and any EAC3 we just added)

★ CONFIGURE: Remove 'dca' from valuesToRemove
  if you want to keep DTS surround tracks.
  (DTS will cause Plex iOS to transcode audio.)

Remove Incompatible Audio Codecs (incl. DTS)
★ Config: add/remove codecs from valuesToRemove

── STEP 5: REORDER STREAMS ───────────────────
Puts stereo AAC first for maximum compatibility.

Final stream order:
  [0] Video (HEVC — stream copied)
  [1] Stereo AAC 2.0  ← FIRST audio track
  [2] EAC3 5.1 surround (if present)
  [3+] AC3 surround (if present)

This ensures video.js, Plex Web, and basic
players default to the compatible stereo track.

★ CONFIGURE:
  - languages: add your library's primary language
  - channels: '2,6,8' keeps stereo first

Reorder Streams (stereo AAC first)
★ Config: channels=2,6,8 | langs=eng,und

── STEP 6: EXECUTE ───────────────────────────
Runs FFmpeg with stream-copy for all existing
streams plus the new audio tracks.

This is much faster than full transcoding:
  • Video: stream-copied (no quality loss)
  • Existing compatible audio: stream-copied
  • New EAC3 5.1: encoded from surround source
  • New stereo AAC: encoded from surround source
  • Processing time: seconds to low minutes

Execute FFmpeg Command
(stream-copies video; encodes new audio only)

── STEP 7: DURATION VALIDATION ───────────────
Verifies the output duration is within 2% of
the source duration.

Why check duration?
  A corrupt FFmpeg encode can sometimes produce
  a file that plays but is truncated or extended.
  Duration validation catches these silently
  broken outputs before replacing the original.

Note: File size is NOT checked here since adding
audio tracks will always increase size slightly.
This is expected and acceptable.

★ CONFIGURE:
  - greaterThan: 98 (minimum 98% of source duration)
  - lessThan: 102 (maximum 102% of source duration)

Validate Output Duration
★ Config: greaterThan=98, lessThan=102
(output must be 98–102% of source duration)

⚠ DURATION MISMATCH — SENDING TO REVIEW
Output duration is outside the 98–102% range.
Original file is preserved unchanged.

Likely causes:
  • Corrupt source file (see health check)
  • FFmpeg error during audio encode
  • Very short clip with container overhead

Flag for Review
(duration outside expected range; original preserved)

── STEP 8: REPLACE ORIGINAL ──────────────────
Replaces the original file with the audio-fixed
version (new AAC/EAC3 tracks + reordered streams).
Replace Original File with Audio-Fixed Version

── STEP 9: POST-PROCESSING NOTIFICATIONS ──────
Optional notifications after file replacement.
Controlled by variables set at the top of the flow.

Plex Notify (enable_plex_notify = 'true'):
  Triggers a Plex library refresh so Plex
  immediately picks up the new file/codec info.
  ★ Configure the 'Notify Plex' webRequest node:
    - Update the URL with your Plex server IP
    - Replace YOUR_PLEX_TOKEN with your token

Radarr/Sonarr Notify (enable_arr_notify = 'true'):
  Notifies *arr to refresh metadata.
  ★ Configure the 'Notify Arr' node:
    - arr: 'radarr' or 'sonarr'
    - arr_host: your *arr URL
    - arr_api_key: Settings → General → API Key

Check: enable_plex_notify == 'true'?
(YES → send Plex refresh | NO → skip)

Notify Plex: Refresh Library
★ CONFIGURE: Update URL with your Plex IP and token
  URL format: http://PLEX_IP:32400/library/sections/all/refresh?X-Plex-Token=TOKEN

Check: enable_arr_notify == 'true'?
(YES → notify Radarr/Sonarr | NO → skip)

Notify Radarr or Sonarr
★ CONFIGURE: Set arr, arr_host, and arr_api_key
  arr: 'radarr' or 'sonarr'
  arr_host: http://YOUR_ARR_IP:PORT
  arr_api_key: from Settings → General → API Key
  (Duplicate this node to notify both apps)
